note: 1.6.0 (FW-0061): a pilot portal's tabs (contract 1). {name} is the pilot's name. Card types: the pilot's own card copies (custom:flight-watcher-<x>-card-{name}), heading, tile, entity, toggle and static markdown (text only, no templates). No tickets or uploads card. 1.6.2 (Release A item 13): the Watcher tab has the working flight, the open time pot and Tradeboard pickups and the CrewTrac charters card; the Schedule tab has the FLICA requests, where the Request decided alert opens. 1.6.2 review: no State, Last check or Next check rows under the clock card. 1.6.2 (Ryan 2026-11-10): the Settings tab has the Hunt interval tile again (every instance hunts every 5 to 90 s, all of which contract 1 sends; the pilot's 120 s floor is gone) and a line that the Watcher keeps a pilot within 100 FLICA loads an hour; normal is 1 to 20 min from the portal until Release C revises contract 1 (the Watcher itself takes 1 to 90). 1.7.0 (Release C, contract 1 revision 2): a 6th tab, Tickets, last (the five before it keep their places in the tab bar; its title is short): the pilot's own tickets card, where the ticket fixed alert opens.

cards.content:
- **Scan FLICA now** reads the open time pot and the Tradeboard right away, and your schedule too unless a schedule read is backing off (the Schedule tab says when it tries next). It is a full check, so use it when you need it (a press within 10 s of the last check is ignored). Each press uses a few of your 100 FLICA page loads an hour: pressing it over and over can leave the Watcher waiting up to an hour for the budget.
- **Hunt mode** checks at your hunt interval (5 to 90 s, on the Settings tab), or as often as your FLICA budget keeps up (below); off is normal speed.
- Every wait varies by up to 30 %, so FLICA never sees a fixed rhythm.
- The Watcher keeps you within 100 FLICA page loads an hour. That keeps up about one check every 1.5 min (a little longer once the close-in folder is found), so a shorter hunt runs at that pace: a 5 s and a 60 s hunt check about as often. The status line then says the hunt is held to that budget.
- **Pause** only if you log in to FLICA yourself for a long time. The Watcher also steps back on its own when it sees your login: 30 min, longer if you log in again within 6 h (up to 4 h).
- **Scan CrewTrac now** logs in to CrewTrac once to look for charters (at most one press every 30 min). If CrewTrac refuses your user ID or password, the Watcher stops trying until you save new CrewTrac details on the Settings tab.
- FLICA is read only: the Watcher never submits, drops, swaps, adds or bids. CrewTrac is read only too.
The Recall/O75 miss check follows the 2023 PWA, 22.G.2. A CCR is never filed for you from here: the card drafts the narrative only.

Hunt: every 5 to 90 s. Normal: every 1 to 20 min (longer normal intervals come to the portal in a later update). Every wait varies by up to 30 %. The Watcher keeps you within 100 FLICA page loads an hour, which keeps up about one check every 1.5 min (a little longer once the close-in folder is found): a shorter hunt or normal interval runs at that pace, and the status line says so.

Bug reports and feature requests go to Ryan, who works them with his assistant. Other pilots never see your tickets. Up to 3 photos a ticket, and 10 new tickets a day. When one is fixed you get an alert here (and on ntfy once it is set up): check it, then tap Verified, close or Still broken.
